title: SYED HAIDER ADNAN- VS -the state
text:
Form No: HCJD/C-121 
ORDER SHEET. 
IN THE ISLAMABAD HIGH COURT, ISLAMABAD. 
JUDICIAL DEPARTMENT. 
Criminal Misc. No.02 of 2026  
Syed Haider Adnan 
 
VS 
 
The State 
 
S. No. of 
order/ 
proceedings 
Date of  
order/ 
Proceedings 
Order with signature of Judge and that of parties 
or counsel where necessary.  
05.01.2026
Khawaja Sajid Saif, Advocate for the petitioner 
alongwith the petitioner.   
 
 
 
Through the instant petition, the petitioner 
Syed Haider Adnan s/o Adnan Masood, seeks 
protective bail in a case F.I.R No. 20/2025, dated 
07.01.2025, offence under Section 489-F P.P.C., 
registered with Police Station Fareed Nagar, District 
Pakpattan, Punjab. 
 
2. 
It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that on account of imminent threat of 
arrest, the petitioner is not able to approach the 
Court of first instance and, therefore, he may be 
granted protective bail.  
 
 
3. 
The accused namely Syed Adnan Haider is 
granted ad-interim transitory bail for Ten (10) days. 
Accused is directed to approach the Court of 
competent jurisdiction on or before 15.01.2026. 
Instant bail granting order shall cease to exist and 
expire automatically after the Court hours of 
referred date i.e. 15.01.2026. 
 
4. 
The instant petition stands disposed of in the 
above terms.   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
          (MUHAMMAD ASIF)      
                      JUDGE                        
Ahmed Sheikh 
 
Copy Dasti
